hypothesis: A bounded increase in exposure to existing accepted partial-front-rich training images may improve partial-front detection and visible-box localization at a fixed image and optimizer-update budget.

sampling.cohort_selection_rule: accepted_r28_review AND >=1 zero-corner object AND >=8 zero/one-corner objects AND partial fraction >=1/3
sampling.omission_rule: Shuffle eligible nonempty noncohort training IDs once with a private seed-46 RNG. Rotate nine omissions per epoch through this fixed cyclic list; replace those positions in the ordinary sampler order with the nine cohort IDs.
sampling.dose_status: A bounded prespecified hypothesis, not calibrated optimal weighting. Whole-image exposure also repeats ordinary fronts and background.

evaluation.decision: Compare the two fresh R28-label sampling roles and retained PR35 at the existing fixed inference settings. Preserve frozen666 primary and historical663 reference reports, with the accepted R28 661-front review explicitly separate and exploratory. Evaluate all zero/one-corner fronts as well as the previously diagnosed 13 misses; record gains, losses, two-corner recall, 5/10-pixel pair success including eligible misses, unmatched outputs, duplicates and empty-scene outputs. The experiment tests sampling, not new labels. Do not tune thresholds, epochs or seeds after seeing the result. No automatic promotion or new-session reliability claim.

scope: No annotation changes; accepted R28 supervision and existing split/held/exclusion policy are used in both roles.
Control and candidate are experimental sampling roles; both use the staged R28 candidate label arm.
The entire 157-image collection is not an independent test. The 20 development images remain excluded from training.
Selection is based only on eligible training annotations and original-pixel analogue inspection; it uses no development image coordinates or model scores.
All 137 training images remain represented over the full run; all 13 empty scenes and all 32 held/excluded-from-amendment photos keep one presentation per epoch.
The cohort includes nearby views. Image count does not imply independent capture sessions.
This is R29 experiment naming only; there is no new R29 annotation snapshot.
